from scipy.ndimage import label

def predict(inp):
    import numpy as np
    a=np.array(inp); bg=int(a[0,0]); out=a.copy()
    # Identify full-width band panels by rows whose first and last cells match and interior has uniform majority value
    panels={}
    for r in range(a.shape[0]):
        fill=int(a[r,1]); edge=int(a[r,0])
        if a[r,0]==a[r,-1] and np.all(a[r,1:-1]==fill) and edge!=fill and fill!=bg:
            panels.setdefault(fill, []).append(r)
    bands={}
    for fill, rr in panels.items():
        groups=[]
        for r in rr:
            if not groups or r!=groups[-1][-1]+1: groups.append([r])
            else: groups[-1].append(r)
        bands[fill]=(groups[-1][0],groups[-1][-1], int(a[groups[-1][0],0]))
    # clear whole top input object zone
    # component labeling on top (all rows before first panel)
    topend=min((v[0] for v in bands.values()), default=a.shape[0])
